g.text: Which incantations make it to the screen?

g.text: The 20 most frequent spell families across all seven books and eight films. Rates adjust for dialogue length.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: Filled circles: books with spelling variants. Small open circles: strict book spelling. Triangles: films with variants.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: A mention may be casting, an attempt, a lesson or a quotation. It is not a count of successful spells or all on-screen magic.

g.text: Lumos, Protego, Reparo, Finite and Bombarda variants are grouped into documented families. Counts and strict sensitivity: spell_totals.csv.
